_comment: Shape: key -> BCP-47 tag -> text. The tags here are the supported locales (IPaymentOptionProvider.SupportedLocales): a new language needs a row on every key, and its name in SupportedLocales' XML docs. The tests fail if a key misses a tag.
'en-US' is required on every key and is the fallback when a locale has no row.
pop.button is a FORMAT: {0} is the store's name, or where its logo goes. Put it where the language puts the name; text after it is drawn after the logo.
Badges are deliberately absent: the game supplies badge text itself, so nothing here translates it.

pop.header.en-US: How would you like to pay?
